title: Botanik
description:
Coming soon - Grunn!

Об игреBotanik is a small relaxing game about a geometric-shaped gardener that takes care of various plants. 

Note: a working internet connection is required to play this game.

Features
• At least 10 minutes of playtime (and way more if you enjoy watering your plants).

• Take care of your own plants.

• Relax in your own glasshouse.

• Visit the gardens of other players.

• Cute characters and animations.

• Unlock new seeds by taking good care of your plants.

Controls
• Left mouse button to move camera & interact.
